shortDescription: Crude palm oil prices are expected to remain above 4,700 ringgit ($1,154) per ton in October and through the rest of the year underpinned by weather uncertainty and favourable energy markets, the Malaysian Palm Oil Council said on Tuesday.($1 = 4.0740 ringgit)
